webSearch.apiKey.label: Exa API Key
webSearch.apiKey.help: Exa Search API key (fallback: EXA_API_KEY env var).

webSearch.baseUrl.label: Exa Search Base URL
webSearch.baseUrl.help: Optional Exa Search API base URL override. OpenClaw appends /search when the URL does not already end there.

webSearch.localBaseUrl.label: Exa Local Broker URL
webSearch.localBaseUrl.help: Optional literal loopback HTTP endpoint. Redirects and alternate hosts remain blocked.

webSearch.maxResults.label: Exa Maximum Results
webSearch.maxResults.help: Maximum result count exposed by the Exa tool (1-10).
